builds.name: Reference: Ranked mid core
builds.goal: Reference for Katarina: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ mid players use most (6,802 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 47.3% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A reset-driven melee assassin who positions around daggers and enters after enemy interruption tools are spent. The current mid provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Lich Bane → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass. Electrocute keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff.
builds.summary: The proven mid baseline: Lich Bane → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass, with Electrocute.
testPlan: Play it in mid as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Lich Bane → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 47.3% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Lich Bane → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

builds.name: Mixed Death Lotus channel
builds.summary: Explore Lotus's explicit attack-speed-linked physical term.
builds.goal: Explore Lotus's explicit attack-speed-linked physical term.
builds.hypothesis: Death Lotus knives have 0.19 AP magic damage and an AD statFormula expression multiplied by an attack-speed-stat term. Gunblade and Nashor supply mixed/AP offense while Rageblade supplies attack speed; Blade and Terminus serve real attacks woven before the channel. Any R item on-hit delivery is a separate unverified component, so this route first tests documented knife scaling.
testPlan: Required state: Need safe preparation attacks, enemy interrupt tools spent and an uninterrupted 2.5-second channel.
Compare Lotus physical/magic totals at two attack-speed values, with all item procs logged separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Interrupts erase most value; mixed penetration needs attacks before R and magic Q loses raw AP.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Fifteen knives are not fifteen full-strength ordinary on-hit attacks for every item.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Hextech Gunblade, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.

builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Katarina: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A reset-driven melee assassin who positions around daggers and enters after enemy interruption tools are spent. Fix dagger pickup and R duration, and verify each ability's current on-hit effectiveness. Reset opportunities and enemy interrupts matter more than a fully channeled stationary target. Health/AP may sustain close spell pressure and debuff targets for allied magic damage.

Start with the early core (Riftmaker or Liandry, then the other) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: None. Do not treat mana regeneration as None recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health/AP may sustain close spell pressure and debuff targets for allied magic damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

builds.name: Dagger corridor burn skirmisher
builds.summary: Reward repeated dagger pickups while buying survival through a reset.
builds.goal: Reward repeated dagger pickups while buying survival through a reset.
builds.hypothesis: Voracity dagger pickup deals magic damage with AD and level-varying AP terms; pickups reduce Shunpo cooldown and takedowns reduce all abilities by 15 seconds. Rylai may keep enemies near dropped daggers, while Liandry/Riftmaker reward actual repeated magic contact. Visage supports received omnivamp healing once Riftmaker ramps, rather than inventing an innate dagger heal.
testPlan: Required state: Need accessible daggers, continued combat and a qualifying takedown for the next full cycle.
Count pickups, E cooldown reductions and post-ramp healing across a moving-target eight-second skirmish.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Targets move away from daggers; waiting for sustained effects may sacrifice the first reset.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: A pickup cooldown reduction does not mean unconditional instant E resets at every level.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
